# FDG4042

> DO name flag enums with plural nouns or noun phrases and simple enums with singular nouns or noun phrases.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8 Enum Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

The same guideline as FDG3060 and FDG3061 (section 3.5.3); not machine-checkable, because plural and singular nouns cannot be told apart reliably.

## From the book

See section 3.5.3 for details.
